item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed implementation of seven recommendations arising from its Operation Aviemore investigation.
item.support: This report details the actions taken by Police responding to those recommendations.

item.text: The recommendations addressed police interviewing, understanding and applying investigation powers, and police procedures.
item.support: improvements relating to interviewing practices, the understanding and implementation of the Criminal Investigation Act 2006 (CI Act) and the Police Manual.

item.text: The Commission considered five recommendations implemented, with further work needed on cultural awareness training and interviewees' understanding of cautions.
item.support: The Commission considers five of the seven recommendations have been implemented

item.text: It planned to assess progress on the two outstanding recommendations in 2019.
item.support: will review progress on two recommendations in 2019.

item.quote: The Commission considers five of the seven recommendations have been implemented and will review progress on two recommendations in 2019.
